title: VillageCraft 3 Essentials
description: The custom mod used in the VillageCraft 3 Modpack.
body:
![VillageCraft 3 Essentials Logo](https://media.forgecdn.net/attachments/description/null/description_2bac4053-a440-4189-88f3-c877108f6c20.png)    VillageCraft 3 Essentials is a mod build for the VillageCraft 3 Modpack which is used on the VillageCraft 3 Server, a private SMP. This mod adds custom ores to use as currency, which are copies of diamonds in every way. The other feature added is the ATM, a block which allows you to exchange currencies with randomized exchange rates. It also converts currecny tools to another currency like diamond to ruby. There is also a number of features that are designed to be used on the offical private server including commands and [luckperms](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/luckperms) intergration. This mod has been forked from the previous version ([VillageCraft 2 Essentials](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/villagecraft-2-essentials)) made by us for use in the new private server.   Versions labeled pre-v are pre-releases, they are marked as Beta. These versions do not contain all features for their update/version and may not work correctly.   ## **Installation Requirements** ###### [![NeoForged · GitHub](https://avatars.githubusercontent.com/u/138629134?s=160&v=4)](https://projects.neoforged.net/neoforged/neoforge) NeoForge   ## **FAQ**

Q: When will VillageCraft 2 Essentials be ported to version x?

A: VillageCraft 3 Essentials will only update to the minecraft version that both the offical private server and modpack uses. Currently this is 1.21.1. Before full release, this mod may be updated to newer versions if required.


Q: Will VillageCraft 3 Essentials be ported to another modloader, e.g. Fabric or back to Forge?

A: It will stay on Neoforge as that is the modloader VillageCraft 3 Server and Modpack will always use. However feel free to try something like Sinytra Connector.

 

Q: Can I use this mod in my own Modpacks?

A: Yes, if you provide credit to Timeship Modding. (The development team)

 

Q: Can I create Videos on the mod?

A: Of course, but please mention or show the Curseforge or Modrinith mod page/links. That would help us out a ton. And just make sure the viewers know you are not apart of the actual server.

 

Q: Can I Repost this mod?

A: No. Do not repost this mod anywhere publicly. The only place players should be able to download it is on Curseforge and Modrinith from Timeship Modding.
